name: Metric Computation (PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS)
definition: Computes evaluation metrics (PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS) between the ground truth and predicted images.
summary: Metric Computation (PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS) quantifies novel-view synthesis fidelity by comparing RGB pixel-space and perceptual feature-space differences, distinct from depth-specific metrics.
